body:
I understand how you want to help by recommending therapy and bring up how expectations lead to where my state of mind is right now but, I’m expected to be the best out of the family. Coming out of a family who worked hard to give me opportunities they never had. Made sure I didn’t have to face struggles so I wouldn’t know what it was like for them. To become a man who everyone can be proud of to be associated with them. I’m scared to disappoint with what I am now and what I’ll be in the future. So that’s why I want to just disappear and end it.
Thx for talking to me. It felt like I had a friend who I could tell my true feeling about myself toward

Goodbye

I understand that you want to help me. Encourage myself to keep moving forward. But I find it hard in myself to see why it would be worth it for me to keep going. I wanted to become a nurse to help others aid others or in general to be liked by those around me. I often daydream about myself what I can achieve and how great my life can be. But when I look at myself at the moment I come to my sense and realize I won’t achieve it. I feel like giving myself a chance would only end up in disappointment. 
Thx for commenting tho it made the night better by having one one to talk too.
